official.enum:
typedef enum
{
    /*
    Key id enum.
    Damon V. Caskey
    2013-12-27
    */

    SDID_MOVEUP,
    SDID_MOVEDOWN,
    SDID_MOVELEFT,
    SDID_MOVERIGHT,
    SDID_ATTACK,
    SDID_ATTACK2,
    SDID_ATTACK3,
    SDID_ATTACK4,
    SDID_JUMP,
    SDID_SPECIAL,
    SDID_START,
    SDID_SCREENSHOT,
    SDID_ESC
} e_key_id;

macros._menutextm: #define _menutextm(f, l, shift, s, args...) font_printf(_strmidx(f,s, ##args)+(int)((shift)*(fontmonowidth((f))+1)), _liney(f,l), (f), 0, s, ##args)
